notes.claim: On a plot of voltage against current for an ohmic device, the slope of the line is the resistance.
Resistance is measured in volts per ampere, which is the ohm.
In many materials, resistivity depends approximately linearly on temperature, so a line fits.
On a force against extension graph for a spring, the gradient equals the spring constant.
A marine engineering syllabus expects the law of a straight line graph in the form y = ax + b, with a and b defined.

sources.title: 9.4 Ohm's Law - University Physics Volume 2 | OpenStax
sources.quote: A plot is made of the voltage versus the current, and the result is approximately linear. The slope of the line is the resistance, or the voltage divided by the current.

sources.title: 19.1 Ohm's law - Physics | OpenStax
sources.quote: The units of resistance are volts per ampere, or V/A.

sources.title: 9.3 Resistivity and Resistance - University Physics Volume 2 | OpenStax
sources.quote: In many materials, the dependence is approximately linear and can be modeled using a linear equation

sources.quote: The gradient of the graph of force (y-axis) and extension (x-axis) is numerically equal to the spring constant
